title: Mandarin Oriental Miami Has Sold $1.7B of Condos Before Groundbreaking
summary: Swire Properties' Residences at Mandarin Oriental on Brickell Key has booked $1.7 billion in pre-construction sales; its 66-floor south tower of 228 residences is 80% sold and the 33-floor north tower, with a 121-room hotel, is 25% sold. Buyers are 65% domestic and many pay all cash. Prices are up 30% since 2024 sales began; groundbreaking is this month, with completion projected for 2030.

title: SharkNinja Founder Sells Palm Island Mansion for $60.9M, $4,700 Per SF
summary: An entity tied to SharkNinja founder Mark Rosenzweig sold the 13,000 SF waterfront house at 73 Palm Avenue for $60.9 million to a trust named for the address; it last traded in 2019 at $24.6 million. Other Oct. 2 deals: a $24.1 million Morningside flip (bought for $16 million last year), a $19.8 million Hibiscus Island home, and a $17 million Fisher Island condo at about $4,000 per SF.

title: Lenders Deal Out $436M for South Florida Projects, Led by JSB's $238M Doral Refi
summary: JSB Capital refinanced the 631-unit Landmark South in Doral with a $238 million floating-rate, interest-only bridge loan from Torchlight Investors, about $377,000 per unit; Walker & Dunlop arranged it. Fuse Group and KREA Developments got a $127 million Madison Realty Capital loan on the 502-unit Arcadian in Fort Lauderdale ($253,000 per unit). Lenders describe a conservative market where mid-market deals are harder to place than large ones.

title: Monarch and Tourmaline Seek $400M-Plus for Brickell's 801 Brickell Office Tower
summary: The owners hired Eastdil Secured to sell the 28-story, 437,000 SF tower at about $900 per SF, which would be a Brickell office record; they paid Nuveen $250 million in 2023, Florida's priciest office sale that year. In-place rents run about 40% below Brickell asking rates, which averaged $90.25 per SF this summer per Savills, giving a buyer mark-to-market upside.

title: Larry Ellison Lists North Palm Beach Estate for a Record $165M, Double His 2021 Price
summary: The Oracle founder is asking $165 million for his 8.4-acre Seminole Landing compound at 12210 Banyan Road, which he bought for $80 million in 2021 and first listed at $145 million in 2022. The 16,300 SF, seven-bedroom 1991 house has more than 550 feet of water frontage; the ask is a North Palm Beach record at over $10,000 per SF, or $19.6 million per acre. K2 Realty's Paul Kaneb and James Kenny have the listing.

title: Orlando Apartments Shake Off Oversupply as Construction Falls 66% From 2023 Peak
summary: Orlando's multifamily market is stabilizing after a post-pandemic supply glut that pushed rents negative and forced concessions. Construction activity is down 65.9% from its 2023 peak and 40% year over year, and brokers at Cushman & Wakefield, Berkadia and Marcus & Millichap say demand from population and job growth is absorbing new units. Investors are returning to Central Florida, though selectively.

title: Chrysler Heir Sells Off-Market Palm Beach Everglades Island Home for $28.8M
summary: Jack F. Chrysler III sold his late mother's 5,000 SF waterfront house at 593 Island Drive for $28.8 million (about $5,850 per SF), its first sale in nearly 30 years; she paid $1.9 million in 1997. Bank of America provided the anonymous buyer a $19.5 million loan, and Douglas Elliman brokered both sides. Neighbors at 608 Island Drive ($40M in September), 757 Island Drive ($93.3M in May) and 690 Island Drive ($39.2M in June) point to a firm ultra-luxury island market.

title: Apollo Co-Founder Josh Harris's Firm, Atria Health Lease Space at Miami Design District's Sweetbird North
summary: Josh Harris's private equity firm and Atria Health and Research Institute (55,000 SF on floors four and five) signed leases at Sweetbird North, the 120,500 SF Snohetta-designed office-retail building at 95 NE 40th Street from Craig Robins' MDDA and Raycliff Capital. The project closed a $125 million Credit Agricole construction loan in August, broke ground this week and targets early-2028 completion, a sign of continued corporate relocation demand for trophy office.

title: Macquarie Lists Boca Center's 379,000 SF Office Campus, Eyeing About $200M
summary: Macquarie Capital hired Newmark to sell the three-building Class A campus at 5100 and 5200 Town Center Circle and 1800 North Military Trail in Boca Raton; $200 million would be about $528 per SF. The complex is 86% leased to tenants including JPMorgan, PwC, EY, UBS and FINRA, and Newmark says in-place rents run about 22% below market. Brokers pitch Boca as value next to pricier Miami and West Palm Beach office.

title: Freddie Mac 30-Year Mortgage Rate Jumps to 7.28%, Up 25 bps in a Week
summary: Freddie Mac's weekly survey put the 30-year fixed at 7.28% as of October 1, up from 7.03% a week earlier and 6.34% a year ago; the 15-year averaged 6.60%, up from 6.42%. Mortgage News Daily's daily index sits near 7.57% with the 30-year jumbo average at 7.66%, keeping financing costs a headwind for luxury and leveraged commercial buyers.

title: Billionaire Chris Rokos Sells Manalapan Oceanfront Estate for $83.2M, Down From $150M Ask
summary: Hedge fund founder Chris Rokos sold his 2.8-acre, 29,500 SF estate at 1370 South Ocean Boulevard with 300 feet of ocean frontage for $83.2 million (about $2,800 per SF), more than double the $40 million paid in 2017. It first asked $150 million, later cut to $135 million. William Raveis's Jack Elkins represented the seller and Premier Estate Properties' Rosalind Clarke the undisclosed buyer; the land is prime for a teardown or full renovation.

title: 30-Year Mortgage Rate Hits 7.60%, Highest Since November 2023; Jumbo Average Reaches 7.66%
summary: Mortgage News Daily's index of top-tier 30-year fixed rates rose to 7.60% on September 30, up from 7.50% on September 28 and the highest since November 1, 2023, while the 30-year jumbo average climbed to 7.66%. The 10-year Treasury yield is near 5.3% and the 30-year bond hit its highest level since 2002 as markets reprice Fed policy, inflation and Treasury supply. Freddie Mac's weekly PMMS last printed 7.03% (Sept 24); the next survey is out October 1.

title: Publix Pays $83.3M for 205,000 SF Airpark Plaza Near Miami International Airport
summary: Publix Super Markets bought the seven-building Airpark Plaza at 5705 NW 7th Street from First Washington Realty for $83.3 million, about $407 per square foot; the center last sold for $32.9 million in 2008. Burlington and Alain's Design Furniture are other anchors. The deal lifts Publix's Florida shopping-center purchases over the past two years to roughly $410 million as the grocer buys the centers its stores anchor, including Fountains of Boynton ($78M) and Aberdeen Square ($24M) this year.

title: Ken Griffin Closes $1.1B All-Cash Purchase of Mana Wynwood for a Carnegie Mellon Miami Campus
summary: Citadel founder Ken Griffin closed on Moishe Mana's 30-acre Mana Wynwood at 318 NW 23rd Street, including the convention center, Wynwood Marketplace and RC Cola Plant, in an all-cash, no-broker deal roughly three years in the making. About $2 billion of Griffin's record $3 billion gift to Carnegie Mellon will fund a 35-acre Miami campus with industry labs and venture studios, targeting 3,500+ students from 2028. Mana keeps part of his 45-acre Wynwood holdings plus downtown and Allapattah portfolios.

title: Palm Beach County Approves $26M Sale-Leaseback for Related Ross's $290M Convention Center Hotel
summary: County commissioners voted 6-1 to buy the 1.8-acre Related Ross parking lot at 900 South Rosemary Avenue, plus the future 18-story, 400-key Curio by Hilton to be built on it, for $26 million and lease it back for up to 97 years. Related Ross will pay about $1.1 million a year in rent once the hotel opens (rising 3% annually) plus 6% participation rent above $77 million in revenue; the structure avoids property taxes. The county values the completed hotel at $349 million; completion is targeted for 2029.

title: Treo Affiliate Sells New Golden Beach Oceanfront Spec Mansion for $69.5M, 20% Below Original Ask
summary: Meridian Coast LLC, a Delaware entity with a hidden buyer, paid $69.5 million all-cash for the newly built 17,500 SF estate at 255 Ocean Boulevard: seven bedrooms, a guest house and 100 feet of ocean frontage on 0.7 acres. The home hit the market in February at $88.5 million and was last asking $79.5 million. The Treo Construction-linked seller paid $10.7 million for the site in 2021. Douglas Elliman's Dina Goldentayer listed it; the Jills Zeder Group represented the buyer.
